recipe_version.title: Turkish Balik Ekmek: Seared Mackerel Sandwiches with Sumac Onions
recipe_version.description: Skin-on Atlantic mackerel fillets seared crisp and tucked into toasted crusty rolls with shredded romaine, tomato, and a red onion salad tossed with sumac, parsley, and Aleppo pepper, with lemon squeezed over.

ingredients.name: mackerel fillets
ingredients.display_name: skin-on Atlantic mackerel fillets (8 fillets, about 3 oz each)

ingredients.name: crusty rolls
ingredients.display_name: crusty sandwich rolls (about 7 inches) whose label lists wheat flour, water, yeast, and salt

steps.title: Onion salad and prep
steps.body: Toss the sliced onion with the sumac, parsley, Aleppo pepper, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil and let it stand while you cook. Shred the romaine, slice the tomatoes, and cut the lemon into wedges. Pat the fillets dry, run your fingers along them to pull any pin bones, and season the flesh with 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Sear the mackerel
steps.body: Heat 1 tbsp oil in the 12-inch heavy skillet over medium-high, about 2 minutes. Lay in 4 fillets skin side down, press each flat for 10 seconds, and sear until the skin is crisp, about 3 minutes, then turn for 1 minute until just opaque and 145 F. Repeat with the remaining oil and fillets (2 batches).

steps.title: Toast the rolls
steps.body: Split the rolls, turn the heat to medium, and toast them cut side down in the skillet, 2 at a time, about 1 minute per batch.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.body: Fill each roll with romaine and tomato, 2 mackerel fillets, and a heap of sumac onions. Squeeze lemon over and serve with the remaining wedges.
